name: container
description: Chest inspection and item transfer helpers based on Mineflayer container APIs.

chest.description: Chest target. Recommended format: {"position":{"x":9,"y":8,"z":5}}. Compatible format: {"x":9,"y":8,"z":5}.

chest_id.description: Registered chest id from register_chests; maps to a chest position. Alternative to chest/position.

chest_name.description: Registered unique chest name from register_chests. Alternative to chest_id / chest / position.

position.description: Fallback chest block position as {"x":9,"y":8,"z":5}; prefer chest.position when available.

open_timeout_ms.description: Maximum time to wait for a readable container window after activating the chest.

inspect_chest.llm_description: Move to a chest within perception range, open it, and return chest contents plus inventory contents.

chest.description: Chest target. Recommended format: {"position":{"x":9,"y":8,"z":5}}. Compatible format: {"x":9,"y":8,"z":5}.

chest_id.description: Registered chest id from register_chests; maps to a chest position. Alternative to chest/position.

chest_name.description: Registered unique chest name from register_chests. Alternative to chest_id / chest / position.

position.description: Fallback chest block position as {"x":9,"y":8,"z":5}; prefer chest.position when available.

name.description: Minecraft item name, for example iron_sword.

open_timeout_ms.description: Maximum time to wait for a readable container window after activating the chest.

pick_object_from_chest.llm_description: Withdraw requested items from a chest after checking chest quantities and inventory capacity. Use items as [{"name":"iron_sword","count":1}], not as a string array.

chest.description: Chest target. Recommended format: {"position":{"x":9,"y":8,"z":5}}. Compatible format: {"x":9,"y":8,"z":5}.

chest_id.description: Registered chest id from register_chests; maps to a chest position. Alternative to chest/position.

chest_name.description: Registered unique chest name from register_chests. Alternative to chest_id / chest / position.

position.description: Fallback chest block position as {"x":9,"y":8,"z":5}; prefer chest.position when available.

name.description: Minecraft item name, for example iron_sword.

open_timeout_ms.description: Maximum time to wait for a readable container window after activating the chest.

place_object_to_chest.llm_description: Deposit requested inventory items into a chest after checking inventory quantities and chest capacity. Use items as [{"name":"iron_sword","count":1}], not as a string array.

names.description: Optional unique names assigned to chests, keyed by 'x,y,z' block position, e.g. {"9,8,5":"storage"}.

register_chests.llm_description: Scan chest-like blocks (chest/trapped_chest/barrel) within max_distance and assign each a stable numeric chest_id (double chests are normalized to one id). Use chest_id in later container commands instead of coordinates.

list_chests.llm_description: List all registered chests with their chest_id, position, type, and whether they are still present.
